runtime.description: cloud-run (default): a Cloud Run service. cloud-run-job: a Cloud Run job (run to completion, no URL).

service_team.description: Key of a gcp.environments.<env>.service_teams entry: deploy this service into that team's service project instead of the host project.

job.description: Cloud Run job settings (runtime = cloud-run-job only).

slo.description: Service-level objective on the Cloud Run service (runtime = cloud-run only).

enable_org_config_recorders.description: aws-organization: org-wide Config recorders (StackSet to every member account except security tooling, plus the management account). Turn on after aws-security has applied; see docs/runbooks/aws-config-recorder-migration.md.

enable_config_recorder_scp.description: aws-organization: deny-tamper DenyConfigRecorderChanges. Turn on only after the org-wide recorders replaced every legacy recorder (migration runbook, last step).

enable_cloudtrail_delegated_admin.description: aws-organization + aws-security: the organization trail is created and managed from security tooling, the CloudTrail delegated administrator, so the deny-tamper SCP applies to it. Default false. Existing estates: docs/runbooks/aws-cloudtrail-delegated-admin-migration.md.

cloudtrail_delegated_admin_account_id.description: aws-organization: the security-tooling account ID when cloudtrail.amazonaws.com is already delegated to it; imported when enable_cloudtrail_delegated_admin turns on.

allOf.description: Per-cloud conditionals only require org: fixtures and roots are intentionally partial, and each root's Terraform validations name the missing essential keys.
